Pregnant woman delivers baby mid-river during difficult journey to hospital

In Chhindwara district, a pregnant woman experienced labor pains and, unable to get an ambulance, was carried by her family on a cot. They crossed a river, and she delivered the baby mid-journey. The family then transported her to the hospital by motorcycle. The incident highlights issues with rural healthcare and infrastructure.
